articles.summary: Today the gap between shorter-term Treasury bonds and longer-term bonds has moved to about as narrow as it has been since early 2025.  The way it has gotten there has been through rising yields on two-year Treasury notes and falling yields on 10-year Treasurys this month.

articles.title: The Fed says inflation hasn’t gotten any better ahead of its key December vote to raise rates
articles.summary: Just ahead of pivotal December vote to raise U.S. interest rates, the Federal Reserve on Wednesday said stubborn inflation remains a thorn in the side of an expanding economy.

articles.title: Oil Flows in Hormuz Strait 'Forever Altered,' Says Tom Kloza
articles.summary: Tom Kloza, chief energy advisor to Gulf Oil, said that he expects a 'major head fake' from the oil market as the 'seeds' for the next oil rally have been planted and could take gas and diesel prices back up in the beginning of 2027.  Kloza also discussed the continued impact that war with Iran has had on the oil market, and said that his view remains that oil flows in the Strait of Hormuz are 'forever altered' by the conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)
